tests.standards: E2E tests use Playwright configured for multiple browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari/WebKit, Edge) and mobile viewports (iOS Safari via iPhone emulation, Android Chrome via Pixel emulation). Tests run with baseURL localhost:3000, with webServer command starting dev server. Use page.getByRole() and page.getByText() for accessibility-friendly selectors. Accessibility testing uses @axe-core/playwright for WCAG 2.1 AA compliance. Performance testing uses Lighthouse CI with target score >70. Backend integration tests use pytest with pytest-asyncio, following patterns in backend/tests/conftest.py with mock fixtures for Redis and HTTP clients.
